observations: Black Sony PlayStation 4 console, original 'fat' model.
The console has a matte finish on both top panels, suggesting a later revision of the original model (likely CUH-1200 series).
Sony and PS4 logos are visible on the front face in photo 0.
A blue rectangular sticker is visible on the top right of the console in photo 0.
No controllers, cables, games, or receipts are visible in either photo.
Both photos contain a 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermark with the name 'ABUBAKAR ABUBAKAR'.

claims.claim: 10 games including FC 27, God of war 4, GTA 5, Spider man, Sekiro, Resident evil 2 remake
claims.evidence: No games are shown in the photos. Note: 'FC 27' does not exist yet, which suggests a typo or inaccurate description.
No controller is shown in the photos.
The exterior of the console in photo 0 and 1 appears clean without significant scratching.
Requires a clear photo of the warranty seals on the back of the console.
Cannot be determined from static photos.
Requires testing or a video of the console connected.
No receipt is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Games may be digital/account-based rather than physical discs.
risks.proof: A photo of the 10 physical game discs/cases.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having zero games (digital accounts have no resale value).

risks.risk: The controller may be a third-party replica or have mechanical issues (stick drift).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the controller front and back, and a video of it operating the console menu.

risks.risk: The console may have been opened for repair despite claims.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear of the console showing the intact factory warranty seals.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty (common on this model).
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having a broken disc drive.

proof_requests: Photo of all 10 physical game discs/cases.
Photo of the controller (front and back).
Photo of the back of the console showing the warranty seals and ports.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
A short video of the console powered on and loading a game disc.
response.reason: The seller claims significant value in accessories (10 games and a controller) and documentation (UK receipt) that are not pictured. Additionally, the mention of 'FC 27' is a red flag as that title does not exist, necessitating verification of the actual items included.
